title: A back among them
logline: Tourist Season: the seawall crowded, phones up, and among the backs one back in plaid with a small dog at its boot, facing the bay like everyone else and not holding anything up.

panels.composition: The seawall in August from behind a crowd of tourists holding phones up at the bay; among them, one back in blue plaid flannel holding nothing, a small three-legged dog at its boot. The bay gray beyond, and on the screens, blue.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a crowded seawall in August seen from behind with tourists holding up phones at a gray bay that shows blue on their screens, and among them one man in blue plaid holding nothing with a small three-legged dog at his boot, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
